newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends down, May active.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends down, May active.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures ended lower on Monday. Traders said activity centred on book-squaring ahead of the expiry of spot position May.
One leading commission house set the pace and dominated the overall turnover with May/August crosses and AA trades on May.
May/Aug spread narrowed to $2.00 by the close from Friday's $3.30 finish as some players rolled forward their May positions before the April 15 expiry.
By the close, May stood $1.00 down at $309.90 per tonne and August 20 cents lower at $307.90. May formed the bulk of the solid overall volume of 3,144 lots.
Traders noted little arbitrage activity against the New York raws market. May/May was valued at around $67, slightly narrower than on Friday.
